28: @Component({
29:   changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.Eager,
30:   selector: 'app-forgot-password',
31:   templateUrl: './forgot-password.component.html',
32:   styleUrls: ['./forgot-password.component.scss'],
33:   imports: [MatCardModule, TranslateModule, MatFormFieldModule, MatLabel, MatInputModule, FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule, MatIconModule, MatSuffix, MatTooltip, MatError, MatHint, MatSlideToggle, PasswordStrengthComponent, PasswordStrengthInfoComponent, MatButtonModule]
34: })
35: export class ForgotPasswordComponent {
36:   private readonly securityQuestionService = inject(SecurityQuestionService)
37:   private readonly userService = inject(UserService)
38:   private readonly translate = inject(TranslateService)
39: 
40:   public emailControl: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('', [Validators.required, Validators.email])
41:   public securityQuestionControl: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl({ disabled: true, value: '' }, [Validators.required])
42:   public passwordControl: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl({ disabled: true, value: '' }, [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(5)])
43:   public repeatPasswordControl: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl({ disabled: true, value: '' }, [Validators.required, matchValidator(this.passwordControl)])
44:   public securityQuestion?: string
45:   public error?: string
46:   public confirmation?: string
47:   public timeoutDuration = 1000
48:   private timeout
49: 
50:   findSecurityQuestion () {
51:     clearTimeout(this.timeout)
52:     this.timeout = setTimeout(() => {
53:       this.securityQuestion = undefined
54:       if (this.emailControl.value) {
55:         this.securityQuestionService.findBy(this.emailControl.value).subscribe({
56:           next: (securityQuestion: SecurityQuestion) => {
57:             if (securityQuestion) {
58:               this.securityQuestion = securityQuestion.question
59:               this.securityQuestionControl.enable()
60:               this.passwordControl.enable()
61:               this.repeatPasswordControl.enable()
62:             } else {
63:               this.securityQuestionControl.disable()
64:               this.passwordControl.disable()
65:               this.repeatPasswordControl.disable()
66:             }
67:           },
68:           error: (error) => error
69:         }
70:         )
71:       } else {
72:         this.securityQuestionControl.disable()
73:         this.passwordControl.disable()
74:         this.repeatPasswordControl.disable()
75:       }
76:     }, this.timeoutDuration)
77:   }
78: 
79:   resetPassword () {
80:     this.userService.resetPassword({
81:       email: this.emailControl.value,
82:       answer: this.securityQuestionControl.value,
83:       new: this.passwordControl.value,
84:       repeat: this.repeatPasswordControl.value
85:     }).subscribe({
86:       next: () => {
87:         this.error = undefined
88:         this.translate.get('PASSWORD_SUCCESSFULLY_CHANGED').subscribe({
89:           next: (passwordSuccessfullyChanged) => {
90:             this.confirmation = passwordSuccessfullyChanged
91:           },
92:           error: (translationId) => {
93:             this.confirmation = translationId
94:           }
95:         })
96:         this.resetForm()
97:       },
98:       error: (error) => {
99:         this.error = error.error
100:         this.confirmation = undefined
101:         this.resetErrorForm()
102:       }
103:     })
104:   }
105: 
106:   resetForm () {
107:     this.emailControl.setValue('')
108:     this.emailControl.markAsPristine()
109:     this.emailControl.markAsUntouched()
110:     this.securityQuestionControl.setValue('')
111:     this.securityQuestionControl.markAsPristine()
112:     this.securityQuestionControl.markAsUntouched()
113:     this.passwordControl.setValue('')
114:     this.passwordControl.markAsPristine()
115:     this.passwordControl.markAsUntouched()
116:     this.repeatPasswordControl.setValue('')
117:     this.repeatPasswordControl.markAsPristine()
118:     this.repeatPasswordControl.markAsUntouched()
119:   }
120: 
121:   resetErrorForm () {
122:     this.emailControl.markAsPristine()
123:     this.emailControl.markAsUntouched()
124:     this.securityQuestionControl.setValue('')
125:     this.securityQuestionControl.markAsPristine()
126:     this.securityQuestionControl.markAsUntouched()
127:     this.passwordControl.setValue('')
128:     this.passwordControl.markAsPristine()
129:     this.passwordControl.markAsUntouched()
130:     this.repeatPasswordControl.setValue('')
131:     this.repeatPasswordControl.markAsPristine()
132:     this.repeatPasswordControl.markAsUntouched()
133:   }
134: }
135: 
136: function matchValidator (passwordControl: AbstractControl) {
137:   return function matchOtherValidate (repeatPasswordControl: UntypedFormControl) {
138:     const password = passwordControl.value
139:     const passwordRepeat = repeatPasswordControl.value
140:     if (password !== passwordRepeat) {
141:       return { notSame: true }
142:     }
143:     return null
144:   }
145: }
